svg.title: How the two tasks of Lost in the Middle are built
svg.desc: Left: multi-document QA. NaturalQuestions-Open questions, the answer paragraph, Contriever distractors without the answer, a prompt with k documents, dial 1 moves the answer document, dial 2 sets k to 10, 20 or 30, greedy decoding, accuracy. Right: key-value retrieval. Random UUID pairs in a JSON object, one gold key, dial 1 moves the gold pair, dial 2 sets k to 75, 140 or 300, greedy decoding, accuracy. Bottom: closed-book and oracle baselines.
svg.text: How the two tasks are built
